license_note: The model card states that use of the model is governed by the NVIDIA Open Model License, a web-hosted NVIDIA document rather than a file in the repository. The license grants a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free but revocable right to reproduce, modify, and distribute the work with notice obligations and guardrail and indemnity clauses, but it is an NVIDIA-specific instrument, not an OSI-approved license.
